sources.title: What the Machine Invented: Mining New Mathematical Instruments from OpenAI's October 2026 Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
Research on peak shaving of grid capacity for BESS PCS energy storage topology in long-pulse operation of nuclear fusion

lanes.A: Typed equation-candidate gates extended; test suite expanded.
lanes.B: Provider-neutral architecture preserved; no credentials, provider calls, or QPU job.
lanes.C: Classical readable-memory and physical data-movement accounting remain separate from state-space size.
lanes.D: No device/fabrication evidence; D/G co-design remains active.
lanes.E: Fusion grid peak-shaving literature is a model-only driver lead; no bio-oil, Pangola substitution, or net-electricity evidence.
lanes.F: Proof, held-out prediction, counterexample, false-discovery and cost evidence are separated.
lanes.G: No manufacturing-equipment/factory result; device requirements remain evidence-gated.
lanes.H: New dated literature watch preserves strategic master-plan context.

foundational.FND-001: RG040 remains open: no physical energy or accepted-task quality bridge.
foundational.FND-005: No new experimentally validated QFT/particle mechanism.
foundational.FND-006: Formal-proof metadata separated from empirical physical validation.
foundational.EQN-001_to_EQN-006: Candidate schema now explicitly records constraints, held-out prediction, counterexamples, proof/experiment path and false discoveries.

mission.INV-029: No phone-class physical compression or lifecycle-cost evidence.
mission.INV-030: No elemental transmutation or critical-material substitution claim.
mission.INV-031: No saleable bio-oil yield or cost evidence.
mission.INV-032: No net reliable delivered fusion-electricity result.
mission.INV-033: No measured principal, interest or WACC change.
mission.INV-035: Equation candidates remain hypotheses; no physical law promoted.
